outlook.statement: Our 2025-2026 technology industry outlook examines recent challenges in the industry, a renewed focus on growth and innovation, and key considerations for tech leaders in the year ahead.

risks: Spending on technology products and services by our clients and prospective clients fluctuates depending on many factors, including the economic, geo-political, monetary, and fiscal policies and regulatory environment in the markets in which they operate. Our clients may operate in sectors that are adversely impacted by climate change which could consequently impact our business and reputation.
Intense competition, regulatory challenges, data privacy concerns, and economic downturns affecting IT spending.
Interest rate risk on floating rate borrowings (100% of borrowings at variable rate)
Capital risk management challenges with negative equity
